subject.title: [Feature]: Fallback approval mode + model attribution in messages

question: Should OpenClaw core add an opt-in per-agent approval gate before automatic model fallback, and what delivery route, timeout, and resume semantics should it use?
rationale: The remaining request is not a broken existing contract; it adds config surface and changes provider/model fallback reliability, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent behavior.

options.title: Design A Core Approval Gate
options.body: Add a default-off per-agent fallback approval policy after specifying approval delivery, timeout handling, resume behavior, docs, and tests.

options.title: Keep Automatic Fallback Only
options.body: Reject approval gating and rely on existing fallback notices plus `messages.responsePrefix` for transparency.

options.title: Defer To External Orchestration
options.body: Leave core fallback behavior unchanged and document that users needing pre-provider-change approval should orchestrate model selection outside the fallback loop.

recommendation.title: Design A Core Approval Gate
recommendation.body: Add a default-off per-agent fallback approval policy after specifying approval delivery, timeout handling, resume behavior, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans model fallback policy, docs, and config compatibility, where this owner has the strongest recent history in the evidence set.
